about_volty_desc: Volty is a smart energy management system designed for Egyptian homes. Monitor usage in real-time, control devices remotely, and get AI-powered recommendations to lower your electricity bills.
company_description: We specialise in advanced software and smart energy management systems that help Egyptian families reduce consumption and save on electricity bills.
faq_a1: Volty is a smart energy management system for Egyptian homes — monitor usage in real-time, control devices remotely, and get recommendations to reduce electricity bills.
faq_q2: How does Volty save on electricity bills?
faq_a2: Volty analyses consumption patterns, identifies energy-wasting devices, calculates Egyptian tier costs, and sends alerts before you cross into a more expensive tier. Users save 35% on average.
faq_a3: Most smart home devices including AC units, lights, water heaters, washing machines, refrigerators, and any device on a smart plug. Supports up to 15 devices.
faq_q4: Does Volty work with solar panels?
faq_a4: Yes! Volty fully integrates with solar systems — track production, storage, and manage consumption to maximise your solar investment.
faq_a5: Real-time monitoring with device-level tracking, compared against historical patterns to detect anomalies early.
faq_a6: Absolutely. End-to-end encryption on all transfers and storage, with multi-level access permissions protecting your home's privacy.
faq_q7: How does Egyptian tier calculation work?
faq_a7: Volty automatically calculates costs based on Egyptian consumption tiers and alerts you before you reach the next threshold.
faq_q8: Can I schedule devices for specific times?
faq_a8: Yes — the smart scheduling feature runs devices during off-peak or low-cost windows, maximising savings automatically.
faq_a9: Detailed weekly and monthly reports with consumption patterns, peak usage times, per-device cost breakdowns, period comparisons, and personalised recommendations.
faq_a10: Support is available 24/7 via the app, email contact@barmajha.com, or +20 127 066 1064. Online onboarding sessions available for new users.
faq_a11: Yes — a full trial with all premium features, support for up to 15 devices, AI recommendations, free support, and an interactive Arabic guide.
faq_a12: Volty is built specifically for Egyptian homes: Egyptian tier maths, full Arabic interface, 24/7 local support, Egypt-optimised solar integration, and AI trained on Egyptian usage patterns.
ai_local_models: Models running locally on your device
warning_tier: Alert: You may exceed your pricing tier!
tier_tip: Cutting AC usage by 2 hours per day is enough to stay within your current tier and avoid a higher rate.
tier_tooltip: Egyptian electricity is billed in tiers — the more you use, the higher the rate per kWh. This card tells you whether you'll stay in your current (cheaper) tier by month-end.
smart_schedule_sub: Shift devices away from peak hours to cut costs
no_peak_devices: All good — no devices running during peak hours
schedule_tooltip: Running heavy appliances like washing machines and water heaters at night costs significantly less because grid demand is low. This schedule shows the best time slot for each device.
anomaly_sub: Unusual consumption patterns flagged by AI
no_anomalies: All clear — no unusual patterns detected
anomaly_tooltip: The AI compares each device's consumption against its own history. A sudden unexplained spike gets flagged here — helping you catch faults or forgotten devices early.
anomaly_night_desc: Unusually high consumption detected between midnight and 5 AM. Check for devices left running overnight.
anomaly_spike_desc: This device consumed significantly more than its usual average. It may have a fault or was left on unintentionally.
anomaly_idle_desc: This device is drawing power while appearing idle. Unplugging it when not in use could save energy.
anomaly_generic_desc: This device's consumption deviates significantly from its normal pattern.
cost_forecast_sub: Upcoming months based on your current habits
no_forecast_data: Not enough data yet — check back soon
summer_warning: Expect higher consumption in summer. Service your AC filters before May to improve efficiency.
forecast_tooltip: Projected bills for coming months based on your current habits and seasonal trends from previous years.
achievement_sub: Improve your efficiency score to reach the next home rating
behavior_tooltip: Built from your real usage history — no cloud needed. The efficiency score (0–100) reflects how well you avoid wasting energy compared to an ideal profile for your home size.
no_recommendations: No recommendations right now — you're doing great!
recs_tooltip: Each recommendation is ranked by how much money it can save you this month. Stars (⚡) show relative impact — 5 stars means the highest saving.
ai_error_network: Check your internet connection and try again
